name: control-surface-sy181-15k3e-2.0.0
attribution: Fork of EpicLPer's CH552-OpenMacroPad, on Stefan Wagner's (wagiminator) CH55x USB HID code
flash: wchisp flash <file> (ROM bootloader 4348:55e0; config registers untouched)
notes: Superseded by 2.0.1 (fast-rotation fix). Kept for reference; do not offer it for new installs.

hardwareVerification.details: All 24 inputs in order; 3 ccw/3 cw/2 press exact per knob; presses give no stray rotation; key1+key15 together both register. A fast full revolution gave 10-11 of about 20 detents.

knownIssues: Fast knob rotation drops about half the detents: the encoders were sampled in the main loop, which each detent blocked for about 55 ms (four HID reports at the 10 ms poll interval plus a 15 ms tap delay).
